From day 4 that should give the x4 multiplier (needs 40 deaths in the last 5 days). Watch the pool after each day. If it drops toward ~5000 or less, stop killing victims from the place kinds that seem to be shrinking it, and keep national victims (always safe). The pool must stay above 1000. Day1: killed all 11 in the afternoon.

Plan: kill all ~11 daily with quick entries in the AFTERNOON only, so L keeps night, student and home routines (55% of people). From day 4 this should give the x4 multiplier (needs 40 deaths in the last 5 days). Day1: killed all 11 in the afternoon, pool 60k (about 55k real). Day2: killed all 11 in the afternoon. RISK: each place kind L can trace, once he has 3 traced victims from it, cuts the pool by about x0.25 (x0.2 for sector/gazette). Two kinds cut leaves about 3.4k, which is OK. A third kind cut gives about 700, which means caught. So watch the pool: after the first drop (to about 14k) and then the second (to about 3k), work out which kinds are already cut. Do this from the drop factor (0.2 means gazette) and from which places I have killed many from. Then kill only national victims plus victims from the kinds already cut, because those add no new info. Never let the pool fall to 1000 or below.
